name: OpenAlternative

sources.title: OpenAlternative homepage — open source alternatives directory
Advertise page — paid ad tiers ($147/$297/$597 per month)

requirements: Product must be open source — the directory only lists open-source alternatives to proprietary software
Sign-in required before the submit form is shown (email magic link, Google, or GitHub OAuth)
Listings are framed as alternatives to named proprietary tools and display GitHub stars, last-commit date, and license
preparation: Product name, website URL, and public GitHub repository URL
Short description and the list of proprietary products it replaces
Relevant categories/tags; logo/favicon is auto-fetched or uploaded in dashboard
workflow: Open https://openalternative.co/submit — you are redirected to the sign-in screen
Create an account via magic link, Google, or GitHub to reach the submission dashboard
Submit the tool with repo URL and metadata from the dashboard
Await manual review; the tool page appears under the directory once approved
watchFor: The /submit URL renders a sign-in wall — there is no anonymous submission form
Paid tiers on /advertise are site ads/sponsorships, not required for a listing — do not buy them expecting a listing
Closed-source or proprietary products do not belong here
countsAsLive: A public tool page exists on openalternative.co (reachable without login) showing stars, license, and 'Open Source Alternative to' links
unknowns: Exact review criteria and turnaround time — the submission form sits behind login and was not inspected
Whether any paid listing tier exists; only advertising packages are published
